_movie: tarot.dxr: Nanjo and Elly's tarot reading. Card images already carry English names; panels 432-543 are the 4 x 22 fortunes.

432.en:
The Magician - Upright
"Fortune falls from the sky. Your original ideas will be recognized, and it's a good time to start new work. Connections are a gold mine: media, sales and jobs that involve talking look lucky."

433.en:
The High Priestess - Upright
"Like a fish in water. Your specialty will be recognized and bring success. You may find work to throw yourself into in academia, research or the mind."

434.en:
The Empress - Upright
"Strike while the iron is hot. Your efforts are bearing fruit. With your seniors' help, work goes smoothly. Even your gambling luck is not bad. Act on intuition."

435.en:
The Emperor - Upright
"Second to none. A time to show leadership and drive. You have the strength to reach your goals even with bold decisions. Your finances are stable too."

436.en:
The Hierophant - Upright
"Constant dripping wears away stone. Steady effort pays off at last. If a problem arises, take your superiors' advice honestly and it will be easily solved."

437.en:
The Lovers - Upright
"Two heads are better than one. Working with colleagues brings great results. Weigh your gains and losses and you'll come out ahead."

438.en:
The Chariot - Upright
"Nothing ventured, nothing gained. You have the strength to overcome hardship; push through even when it's tough. Problems clear up fast. Strike first and win."

439.en:
Strength - Upright
"The wind blows, but the mountain stands firm. You can lead and show leadership. Even if opposition appears, you'll overwhelm it. Stick to what you believe is right."

440.en:
The Hermit - Upright
"Where there's a will, there's a way. Steady, tireless effort pays off: victory goes to calm strategy and selflessness. You'll meet a teacher you can respect."

441.en:
Wheel of Fortune - Upright
"Good things come to those who wait. Unforeseen changes bring good results. Decide on the spot and adapt. The chance to change jobs you wanted may come."

442.en:
Justice - Upright
"No risk, no reward. Friendships help your work and studies. Money spent on people comes back doubled. Work in law or the courts is lucky."

443.en:
The Hanged Man - Upright
"More haste, less speed. Lots of work in harsh conditions, but your effort will be rewarded. Endure this trial: sacrifice and daily effort lead to success."

444.en:
Death - Upright
"One beam can't hold up a falling house. You've hit a dead end. Plans stall and deals are suspended. Bankruptcy or job loss may loom, but a bold career change is lucky."

445.en:
Temperance - Upright
"Plan first, then fight. Keep things under control and planned work brings good results. Use favorable terms in negotiations and talks will go smoothly."

446.en:
The Devil - Upright
"He who chases the deer doesn't see the mountain. Caught up in past success, are you losing sight of reality? You won't get out of this rut for a while."

447.en:
The Tower - Upright
"Out of the frying pan, into the fire. Others' blunders or your own big mistakes cost you trust, and trouble keeps coming. Avoid clashing with teachers and bosses."

448.en:
The Star - Upright
"Seize the moment. You'll be given the work you dreamed of. Aim high. You're blessed in your relationships too, so teamwork is lucky."

449.en:
The Moon - Upright
"Lend your axe and lose your forest. Beware betrayal by colleagues and scandal at work. Low motivation and mistakes cloud your future."

450.en:
The Sun - Upright
"Where water flows, a channel forms. A time of progress, growth and action. You'll reach your goals and get rewarding work that shows off your talent."

451.en:
Judgement - Upright
"A blessing in disguise. You'll get out of a pinch. Stalled matters improve, and something you'd long given up on may suddenly come true. Keep faith and work at it."

452.en:
The World - Upright
"Every cloud has a silver lining. You'll overcome obstacles and reach your goals. Work and studies are at their peak. With luck on your side, any job will succeed."

453.en:
The Fool - Upright
"Something from nothing. An unexpected success awaits. Intuitive action brings results; aim for the gaps and blind spots. Work that uses your individuality is lucky."

462.en:
The Magician - Reversed
"Even monkeys fall from trees. Ideas won't come and things won't go your way: a time of worry. Watch out for small mistakes and prepare thoroughly."

463.en:
The High Priestess - Reversed
"Pie in the sky. Expected income won't come in, plans go awry, and the future looks unclear. Are you too fussy, or is your research lacking?"

464.en:
The Empress - Reversed
"The fuller the ear of rice, the lower it bows. Are you bored and getting lazy? Live lavishly and keep complaining, and your work and studies will only slide."

465.en:
The Emperor - Reversed
"Barren flowers bear no fruit. All show, no substance. Are your plans unrealistic? Lean on others and you'll be shown how immature you are."

466.en:
The Hierophant - Reversed
"A top that spins itself over. You'll end up isolated from your colleagues, and the support you've had so far may be cut off."

467.en:
The Lovers - Reversed
"The hunter becomes the hunted. You lack focus and keep getting distracted, and that's exactly when unexpected problems hit."

468.en:
The Chariot - Reversed
"Anger and quarrels only lose. Trouble with colleagues may make you want to throw it all away. Fix your haste and temper, or you'll make a serious mistake."

469.en:
Strength - Reversed
"You can't pour two pints into a one-pint jug. You'll feel your limits and lose confidence. Be patient: giving up before you start and slacking off is foolish."

470.en:
The Hermit - Reversed
"You can't see the forest for the trees. You're too tense. Lack of focus means many silly mistakes, and the harder you cut costs, the more it backfires."

471.en:
Wheel of Fortune - Reversed
"Stumbling at the finish line. Surprises will throw your plans off, and unexpected costs will rise. Beware of jumping to conclusions and missed messages."

472.en:
Justice - Reversed
"Chase two hares and catch neither. You can't juggle two jobs. Swayed by others or afraid of losses, you'll make the wrong call."

473.en:
The Hanged Man - Reversed
"Writing on water. You'll toil in vain at unwanted or pointless work, and struggling won't help. A hard time: all you can do is endure."

474.en:
Death - Reversed
"Lose at go, win at shogi. Don't let past failures get you down: it's time for a fresh start. If you're thinking of changing jobs, now is the perfect chance."

475.en:
Temperance - Reversed
"Carrying water in a sieve. You'll be swamped with irregular, useless work. Your efficiency will clearly drop, but, well, it can't be helped."

476.en:
The Devil - Reversed
"After rain, the ground hardens. The worst is nearly over. The economy is turning, and you'll finally be freed from work you hated."

477.en:
The Tower - Reversed
"A savior in hell. Someone will help you solve your problem. But get carried away and you'll pay dearly. Know when to step back."

478.en:
The Star - Reversed
"Aim for a tiger, draw a dog. Do your ambitions ignore your real ability? The gap between dream and reality hurts; short of ideas, you'll stumble often."

479.en:
The Moon - Reversed
"A narrow escape. Your intuition is sharp, and you'll dodge harm in the nick of time. Things are slowly improving, so stay put and watch for now."

480.en:
The Sun - Reversed
"Your worst enemy is yourself. Productivity drops, and lavish spending will have you borrowing money. If your motivation stays this low, you'll lose your job."

481.en:
Judgement - Reversed
"What flourishes must fade. You can't recover from failure; even if you act now, it won't succeed. You may give up on something you worked on for years."

482.en:
The World - Reversed
"Good swimmers drown in rivers. You're stuck in a rut and a slump. Plans fail for lack of preparation and you'll taste defeat. There's a real risk of ruin."

483.en:
The Fool - Reversed
"Easy come, easy go. Your income becomes unstable, and a windfall is unlikely. Do anything reckless and you'll get burned. Be careful."

492.en:
The Magician - Upright
"Your relationship is ready for its next stage. Singles will sense a lovely romance about to begin, très bien!"

493.en:
The High Priestess - Upright
"Your love for the one you've long adored will finally bloom! It's also a good time to put a full stop to a romance that isn't working."

494.en:
The Empress - Upright
"Couples, you may give marriage the green light! Singles will stay in a merry, pop mood."

495.en:
The Emperor - Upright
"Loving matters more than being loved, darling. Push, push, push, and you will win your love!"

496.en:
The Hierophant - Upright
"Someone who supports you will appear. Even if obstacles arise, good advice will see you through."

497.en:
The Lovers - Upright
"You have a chance at a date with the one you admire! Why not call them and ask them out yourself? C'est parfait!"

498.en:
The Chariot - Upright
"You will defeat your rival. A bold love attack is the key point! You have the power to push through any opposition."

499.en:
Strength - Upright
"You can read your partner perfectly. Even if others object, go for the happy ending!"

500.en:
The Hermit - Upright
"A time to get serious. Look carefully and you'll surely find the partner who suits you perfectly."

501.en:
Wheel of Fortune - Upright
"Oh! A destined encounter awaits you! Timing is everything. Why not widen your circle? A fantastic romance is waiting for you!"

502.en:
Justice - Upright
"What a well-matched couple! You're so compatible that even your parents and friends will approve."

503.en:
The Hanged Man - Upright
"To win love, some sacrifice seems unavoidable. But the you of today has the power to clear any trial."

504.en:
Death - Upright
"I sense a farewell... Hasn't a deep gap opened between the two of you without your noticing?"

505.en:
Temperance - Upright
"Friendship will step up into love. Couples would do well to take a little time apart."

506.en:
The Devil - Upright
"You seem quite in a trance. Aren't you blinded? Tying your partner down or clinging to the past is no good."

507.en:
The Tower - Upright
"A sudden parting may come: quarrels, fights with your partner... Be careful! An adventure in a weak moment would be disastrous."

508.en:
The Star - Upright
"Love may begin in a group of friends. Be clear in word and deed. Someone just like your ideal will appear."

509.en:
The Moon - Upright
"Are you uneasy about your love? Stand firm so gossip doesn't sway you. Excuses and lies will be found out at once."

510.en:
The Sun - Upright
"Magnifique! The best couple! Show your feelings straight and you'll surely enjoy an open relationship."

511.en:
Judgement - Upright
"Past heartache will be swept away. Confessing your feelings is good. Couples, keep loving as you always have; that is best."

512.en:
The World - Upright
"The best couple! You will reach a happy ending. Singles can meet their ideal match in this period."

513.en:
The Fool - Upright
"You'll enjoy a free and easy romance. A tricky approach works well. Strike boldly and things will heat up at once!"

522.en:
The Magician - Reversed
"Aren't you so timid that you're confusing your partner? Being more honest about yourself is what matters."

523.en:
The High Priestess - Reversed
"Aren't you fretting only about your weak points? Treat your partner with consideration; that is important."

524.en:
The Empress - Reversed
"Aren't you leaning on your partner too much? Meddling and pointless jealousy... be careful!"

525.en:
The Emperor - Reversed
"You tend to push like a one-man show. Aren't you forcing a selfish love on them?"

526.en:
The Hierophant - Reversed
"Are you anxious because you can't see a future together? Your kindness may be repaid with ingratitude."

527.en:
The Lovers - Reversed
"A fickle time. Beware of cheating and wandering hearts!"

528.en:
The Chariot - Reversed
"A sudden attack is no good. Don't be hasty. Couples, beware of quarrels."

529.en:
Strength - Reversed
"A dangerous gamble. Vanity and bravado could bring everything to ruin."

530.en:
The Hermit - Reversed
"You can't trust your partner, so of course you feel lonely. If love disappoints you, it's because you're too wary and think too much."

531.en:
Wheel of Fortune - Reversed
"You feel out of step with your partner at every turn. Even if it has ended, you can still come back if you act now."

532.en:
Justice - Reversed
"Your feelings seem one-way; this may end as unrequited love. If you have a steady and play around, you'll lose both."

533.en:
The Hanged Man - Reversed
"However much you love and give, it won't be rewarded, because you only think of yourself. Look into your heart once more."

534.en:
Death - Reversed
"Reincarnation. Why not try again with feelings you'd nearly given up on? The you of today can surely express them well, n'est-ce pas?"

535.en:
Temperance - Reversed
"Haven't you grown too comfortable? Being together seems a little tiring. Keep your feelings fresh and in control."

536.en:
The Devil - Reversed
"A time to be freed from your bonds: a chance to say farewell. Your feelings for a partner you were stuck with will fade away."

537.en:
The Tower - Reversed
"I sense a dangerous mood. Endless squabbles: truly a love crisis. And if you give up, the finale will come soon."

538.en:
The Star - Reversed
"If your love disappoints you or things don't go as you hoped, it's because you expect too much. Don't ask too much of your partner."

539.en:
The Moon - Reversed
"Your doubts and hesitation will clear. You'll even see through a false love."

540.en:
The Sun - Reversed
"Aren't you being selfish? Your love is heading for catastrophe."

541.en:
Judgement - Reversed
"Too late. There's no redoing it now. A halfhearted affair or a passing adventure: c'est fini."

542.en:
The World - Reversed
"Haven't you grown too comfortable? An indecisive attitude is no good. Inexperience and immaturity may leave it half-finished."

543.en:
The Fool - Reversed
"This seems to be a love just for fun. Unless you fix your fickleness, you won't find true love."

283.en: > Click the character you want a reading from.

288.en: Nanjo: "Hmph. Tarot is nonsense, but I'll humor you today. So, you want to know your luck in work and studies?"

289.en: Elly: "Bonjour! Have you any troubles of the heart? Fear not, I shall solve them for you."

294.en: > Click the button below to shuffle the cards. Think about what you want to know and shuffle as long as you like. When you're ready, stop shuffling and choose 4 cards.

ops.text: Nanjo: "Which card's meaning do you want to know?"
Elly: "Would you be so kind as to touch the card you'd like explained?"
